prompt: Create an RFP + RFQ event with 1 line item, invite 2 vendors and publish it. One vendor logs into the vendor portal, submits its technical response and then quotes 95 on the RFQ. For the other vendor the buyer submits a surrogate technical response and a surrogate bid of 100. The buyer should see both vendors on the technical stage and on the RFQ.
